comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks damper response to produce repeatable safe carriage stops; record advances a clog through a pipe using a flexible drain rod without kinking it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses recessed-tool alignment, bounded tightening torque, collar rotation, counterholding, and iterative test interpretation. Record uses short compressive strokes, repeated regrasping near the pipe mouth, and buckling control of a segmented rod. Both involve force control, but against different mechanisms and for different abilities.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate evaluates minimum impact energy, velocity range, 12 mm stroke, hard-stop avoidance, rebound/overload, and post-lock drift across two cycles. Record evaluates clog displacement, rod release/rest, and a latched 40-degree kink failure. Candidate's overload, rebound, and drift thresholds remain unspecified; the record nevertheless has a clearly unrelated success state.
comparison.reason: The record tests managing unsupported flexible-member buckling during feed; the candidate tests tuning and retaining a rotary damper setting based on impact dynamics.
